titulo_es: Ask where to send an application

Vart skickar jag ansökan.en: Where do I send the application?

texto: Request administrative information and compare instructions from public sources. **Vart skickar jag ansökan?** means «Where do I send the application?». It relates the expression to the purpose of the text. Look at the connectors and reformulate the idea with your own words before you respond. Sequence 2 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
